title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
description_html: We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the Document Product Group and build agentic frameworks from the ground up. You will design the memory and retrieval systems that let agents reason over long horizons, learn from past interactions, and take reliable action. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs research with the engineering discipline to turn ideas into working systems.  If you want to shape the foundations of how agents remember, retrieve, plan, and act, and you enjoy the ambiguity of 0→1 work, this role is for you.   What You’ll Do    Design and build agentic frameworks from scratch, including planning, tool use, orchestration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.  Architect and implement memory systems for agents (short-term, long-term, episodic, and semantic), including write, consolidation, forgetting, and update strategies.  Build and optimize retrieval systems, including hybrid search, embedding and reranking pipelines, knowledge graphs, and retrieval over structured and unstructured data.  Turn research ideas and recent literature into rigorous prototypes, then partner with engineering teams to harden them for production.  Define evaluation methodologies for agent, memory, and retrieval quality, including benchmarks, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, offline and online metrics, and regression testing.  Build the data pipelines, backend services, and observability needed to operate agentic systems reliably at scale.  Bring a 0→1 product mindset: shape ambiguous ideas into measurable customer impact, and make informed build-versus-adopt decisions.  Collaborate with product, design, research, and engineering partners to integrate these capabilities into customer-facing features.  Stay current with research in agents, memory, retrieval, reasoning, and prompt optimization, and share what you learn with the team.  Mentor engineers and help raise the team’s technical bar.    What You Need to Succeed    Required Qualifications    Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent research experience.  Research background in areas such as information retrieval, NLP, representation learning, or agents and reasoning, demonstrated through publications, patents, open-source contributions, or equivalent applied research.  Hands-on experience building memory and retrieval systems for LLM-based applications, going beyond basic RAG to include design tradeoffs, failure modes, and evaluation.  Demonstrated experience designing and building agentic architectures from first principles (not only configuring existing frameworks), including orchestration, planning, tool use, and multi-agent patterns.  10+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, applied research, or production ML systems.  Strong Python engineering skills, including system design, clean architecture, testing, CI/CD, version control, and code review practices.  Experience taking ML-powered features from 0→1 through production and ongoing iteration.  Experience deploying and monitoring ML and GenAI systems in production.  Strong foundation in classical ML, deep learning, and modern generative AI techniques.  Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.  Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for scalable deployment.  Comfort using AI coding agents to accelerate development.  Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex research to technical and non-technical audiences.    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with vector databases, graph databases, and search infrastructure  Experience with long-context strategies, context engineering, memory compression and summarization, and personalization. Contributions to open-source agent, memory, or retrieval projects.  Experience with prompt optimization frameworks, fine-tuning, and embedding or reranker model training.  Experience with LLM-as-a-judge, agent evaluation, and benchmark design.  Experience with MLOps tooling, experiment tracking, model lifecycle management, and observability for LLM and agent workflows.  Track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction on high-visibility projects. title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Ingestion
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        The Experience    Slack is looking for a senior software engineer to join the Data Ingestion Team. As part of the Data Engineering organization, we build and operate the platform that ingests data from various sources into our Lakehouse with both streaming and batch approaches. Currently, our infrastructure handles 180PB+ of storage, processes ~1T records a day, 400+ data pipelines and 1500+ Active Airflow DAGs. As Slack’s data grows (along with the number of customers, features and employees), the goal of the team is to build a highly scalable and resilient ingestion platform leveraging modern Streaming and Lakehouse technologies.     As a Senior Engineer, you will play a key role in driving our streaming and lakehouse strategies while also building highly scalable services and tools to help our customers acquire large volumes of high quality data at scale and making customers’ interactions with the ingested data pleasant and productive. You will have deep technical skills, be a self-starter, detail and quality oriented, and passionate about driving data driven decisions and having a huge impact at Slack!       What You'll Actually be Doing:     Design and develop highly scalable and resilient streaming and batch pipelines for ingesting and processing structured and unstructured datasets    Design and implement Slack’s Lakehouse solutions and enable production use cases for customers    Improve the reliability and performance of the services/pipelines through AI assisted and/or Agentic solutions and tools.    Automate and handle the lifecycle of datasets (schema evolution, metadata management, change and backfill management, deprecation and migration).    As one of the tech leads, comfortably collaborate with cross functional partners and lead technical initiatives independently end to end.     Be a role model and a multiplier, coaching and mentoring other engineers across the team and the org.    Write, review, or provide feedback on a technical design proposal from others.         You're our person if you have:       U.S. citizenship and willing to undergo a background check for GovSlack authorization. We can not provide visa sponsorship for this role.     7+  years of software/data engineering experience, including experience with building applications using Streaming and Lakehouse technologies, e.g. Kafka/Kafka Connect, Flink/Spark Streaming, Iceberg/Hudi/Delta or equivalent    You have hands on experience and knowledge on building and maintaining batch data pipelines using Spark, Airflow, EMR, S3 or equivalent    You are proficient in object-oriented and/or functional programming languages: SQL, Python, Java/Scala, Go or equivalent    You are skilled at crafting and building robust distributed microservices with tools like Kubernetes, Docker, AWS ECS/EKS, Terraform, Grafana, etc.     Even Better If:     You are familiar with AI-assisted software development and automation and have hands on experience of Claude Code/Codex or equivalent    You have excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills; able to effectively collaborate with cross functional partners and explaining sophisticated technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders    You have high growth expectations for yourself and your team, and a willingness to push yourself and your team to achieve them        This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.      Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Senior Software Engineer- Account Access & Controls
Senior Software Engineer Vice President
description_html: As a Senior Software Engineering Lead, you will drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise applications that power Citi's technology platform. You will lead applications systems analysis and programming activities, partnering with the Technology team to translate business needs into scalable software solutions. This is an opportunity to shape architecture decisions, mentor engineering talent, and deliver high-impact system enhancements at scale.        Responsibilities:      Lead applications systems analysis and programming activities, partnering with multiple management teams to deploy new products and process improvements.    Design and implement system enhancements that resolve high impact technical and business problems, drawing on deep knowledge of industry standards.    Ensure application designs align with Citi's overall architecture blueprint, applying advanced expertise in applications programming.    Define coding, testing, debugging, and implementation standards that improve system flow and software quality.    Build expertise across architecture and infrastructure to connect technical solutions with broader business goals.    Analyze complex technical issues and develop innovative solutions through in-depth evaluation of system and business processes.    Mentor and guide mid-level developers and analysts, allocating project work to strengthen team delivery.    Evaluate risk in technology decisions and escalate control issues transparently to protect Citi and its clients.           Required Qualifications and Skills:      Brings 6+ years of experience in applications development or systems analysis, including hands-on software programming.    Holds a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field.    Operates as a subject matter expert in at least one area of applications development, resolving complex technical challenges.    Manages and delivers technology projects successfully, from design through implementation.    Demonstrates leadership and project management skills, communicating clearly with both technical and business stakeholders while adjusting priorities quickly as business needs shift.    Builds applications using Python, Java, Angular, or equivalent reactive frameworks within microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native architectures.    Integrates systems through REST APIs and Kafka, applies CI/CD and containerization practices such as Docker and Kubernetes, and develops real-time reporting, dashboards, and ETL/ELT data pipelines.    Experience with agentic AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI platforms.   Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience  Master’s degree preferred       What We Offer      You will work in a hybrid model that combines in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home, giving you the structure to connect with global teams and the autonomy to manage your own schedule.     Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.    Collaborate with technology teams across Citi's global network on large-scale application initiatives.    Access ongoing learning and development programs to build advanced engineering and leadership skills.    Take ownership of architecture decisions and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.    Benefit from programs that support your financial wellbeing and long-term career growth.    Build a career path toward senior technical and leadership roles within Citi's technology organization.           Apply now to lead applications development initiatives that shape Citi's technology future.                   ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Development            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Tampa Florida United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $113,840.00 - $170,760.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards.
